description: Narrow capability for pull-request windows, which show content strangers wrote. Their labels are derived from the pull request they show (see crates/specforge/src/pull_request_window.rs), so they are matched by glob. It grants exactly what the window uses: listening for the notices and snapshots it follows, and closing itself on Escape or Cmd/Ctrl-W. The window saves its size through an app command and its title is set from Rust, so it needs no other window permission, and it gets none of the dialog, autostart, notification, menu or tray permissions default.json grants the main window and reader windows (pull-request-viewer: Pull-Request Window Permissions).
